title: Synthesis: no ecology design yet has an E the dynamics decide; c62's Flow-Lenia ecology survives dt/2 but its predators fuse more than they divide, and the prey's extra splits are a density effect
summary: Since 06:00: c43's CIPS consumer contradicted (E is presence, two consumption-off arms); c58's vortex trait climb established. For C:ecology-with-reproduction, c52/c60 divide as pairs, c46's droplets put D and E on different kinds with written E, and c62's Flow-Lenia predators have a written all-or-nothing gate (partial gates leave starved predators alive), survive dt/2, and fuse more than they divide. Next: a minority-kernel gate tuned to be fatal, sampled-at-merge traits, relative-regeneration waste for the vortices.
